newsitem.title: USA: Immune Response says insiders buy stock.
newsitem.headline: Immune Response says insiders buy stock.

text.p: Immune Response Corp on Monday said it has completed a 15.8 million private placement of units to company insiders.
The units consisted of common stock and warrants to purchase common stock and were sold at $7.80 per unit to Chief Executive Officer Dennis Carlo and Director Kevin Kimberlin.

The placement consisted of 2,029,719 unregistered shares plus 2,029,719 unregistered four year warrants with an exercise price of $14. The warrants would be callable if the stock traded at $28 or greater for 45 consecutive days.
Terms of the deal include an initial 25 percent downpayment with the remaining balance covered by a promissory note due September 30, 1997.
The shares and warrants are not transferable for one year and are subject to U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and Nasdaq regulatory restrictions.
